# Components

The visual components the `ui` library provides. Place one in a form, set its
properties, and bind its events to subroutines — from the designer, or by
writing it out directly.

## button

| Property | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `text` | text |
| `left` | int |
| `top` | int |
| `width` | int |
| `height` | int |
| `background_color` | text |
| `color` | text |
| `border_radius` | int |

**Events:** `click`
